desc:
In the Opening Keynote of the first Rails World, Ruby on Rails creator and @37signals CTO David Heinemeier Hansson (@dhh37) covered a lot of ground, including introducing 7 major tools: Propshaft, Turbo 8, Strada, Solid Cache, Solid Queue, Mission Control, and Kamal.
